title: DBS, JPMorgan launch instant tokenized deposit transfers between US and Singapore
why_it_matters: Connecting two banks' permissioned deposit networks gives corporate treasurers a way to move dollar liquidity across jurisdictions outside normal banking hours. The Partior settlement link and its remaining legacy-account maintenance window show both the progress and practical boundaries of interoperable bank-issued digital money.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

DBS, JPMorgan launch instant tokenized deposit transfers between US and Singapore

DBS and Kinexys by JPMorgan have launched cross-bank transfers of tokenized US dollar deposits between Singapore and the United States, with Ant International as the first user and a weekend legacy-account limitation.
